title: POC Stakeholder Communications Timeline
content:
Context:
This is a lightweight comms plan to keep all customer and internal stakeholders aligned during the AtlasHealth POC (6-week engagement). Focus: reduce meeting churn, make decisions visible, document dependencies and sign-off moments.

Goals of this doc:
- Define who hears what, when, and in what channel.
- Establish a minimal external-facing cadence (kickoff, weekly updates, milestone demos, handoff).
- Provide templates for emails/notes so engineering can copy/paste quickly.
- Surface escalation paths and known risks tied to communications.

Primary audiences:
- Customer: AtlasHealth product and infra leads (external)
- Internal: SE team, Solutions PM, Account Exec, Platform SRE contact, Privacy/Legal (as needed)

High-level timeline (by week):
- Week -1 (Pre-kickoff prep):
  - Internal sync (SE + PM + SRE) to confirm runbooks, credentials checklist, and access windows. Owner: Maya.
  - Send pre-kickoff note to customer with agenda and access request 48h before kickoff.
  - Deliverable: Access matrix and test data checklist.

- Week 0 (Kickoff):
  - 60min external kickoff: agenda = introductions, success criteria, timeline, risks, communication norms.
  - Distribute kickoff notes within 4 hours after call.
  - Owner for notes: Diego (scribe).

- Week 1 (Baseline + install):
  - Daily 15m standups (SE internal) to drive install blockers.
  - Weekly 30m customer sync to confirm connectivity and sample inference runs.
  - Send weekly status email on Friday with pass/fail checklist.

- Week 2–3 (Integration & telemetry):
  - Customer demo of baseline inference (end of week 2).
  - Mid-point technical checkpoint (end of week 3) — invite SRE and PM.
  - Share lightweight dashboard link and invite to view traces.

- Week 4–5 (Optimization & acceptance testing):
  - Optimization findings doc delivered (latency, batching, token-cost estimates).
  - Run acceptance test harness; capture artifacts for sign-off.
  - If quality regressions appear, open an RCA ticket and inform stakeholders within 24h.

- Week 6 (Final demo + handoff):
  - Final demo with customer success + AE + infra.
  - Deliver final runbook, cost estimates, and rollout recommendations.
  - Request formal sign-off email from customer.

Communication channels and norms:
- Slack: primary for quick operational sync (channel: #poc-atlashealth). Use threaded messages and pin daily logs.
- Email: weekly executive summary to customer stakeholders and AE. Keep < 6 bullets.
- Confluence: canonical artifacts (runbooks, dashboards, sign-off checklist). Link in every weekly update.
- Zoom: scheduled demos and kickoffs only (no ad-hoc deep debugging).

RACI (communication-focused):
- Kickoff invite & agenda: R = Maya, A = Solutions PM, C = AE, I = Customer PO
- Weekly status email: R = Diego, A = AE, C = Maya, I = Customer technical lead
- Dashboard share + telemetry invite: R = Jonas, C = SRE, I = Customer SRE
- Acceptance test sign-off: R = Customer PO, A = AE, C = Maya, I = Legal (if data used)

Milestone messaging templates (copy/paste):
- Pre-kickoff access request (email):
  Subject: AtlasHealth POC — access items needed before kickoff
  Body: Hi <Name>,
  Quick list of items we need 48–72 hours before kickoff:
  1) Test account + API key / service principal with read/write for test bucket
  2) Network CIDR to whitelist: <ips>
  3) Example sample payloads (5 rows)
  Please reply with items or point to an owner. Thanks — Maya (SE)

- Weekly status update (email):
  Subject: AtlasHealth POC — Weekly Update (Week <n>)
  Body: TL;DR: On track / At risk / Blocked
  Highlights:
  - Completed: <one-liner>
  - Next 7 days: <one-liner>
  - Blockers/action items: <owner>: <action> (ETA)
  Links: Confluence runbook | Dashboard | JIRA tickets

- Escalation notice (email to execs):
  Subject: ATLAS POC — Escalation: <short issue>
  Body: Summary: <what happened>
  Impact: <who/what>
  Immediate mitigation: <what we did>
  Action requested: <decision or resource>
  Contact: Maya Chen (mchen@redwood.ai), +1-415-555-01xx

Acceptance criteria (customer facing, short):
- Functional: sample queries (n=10) produce expected labels or responses with <=5% quality drift vs baseline.
- Performance: median latency for 256-token calls <= 350ms (p95 <= 650ms) in customer environment.
- Cost: estimated steady-state token cost within agreed target (+/- 20%).
- Security: data flows match the agreed network and key management controls.
- Observability: traces/metrics exported to customer dashboard and verified by SRE.

Sign-off checklist to send at close (attach to final email):
- Final runbook uploaded to Confluence
- Acceptance test report attached
- Latency and cost summary attached
- Open action log (0 high-priority items)
- Customer sign-off line included

Known risks and comms playbook:
- Risk: late network approval from customer (impact: delays start)
  Comms: escalate to AE within 48h, propose brownout windows for testing.
- Risk: telemetry not available due to policy constraints
  Comms: offer temporary agent-based tracing capture and schedule a legal review.
- Risk: unexpected cost spike during load tests
  Comms: pause tests, notify AE and customer, share cost containment steps.

Weekly update structure (internal copy for SEs):
- Status: green/yellow/red + 1-sentence rationale
- Completed this week (bullets)
- Blockers (owner + ETA)
- Requests from customer/AE
- Notes to escalate (yes/no)

Quick meeting etiquette (for POC calls):
- Start on time, 2-min roundtable for updates, pick 2 action items max, assign owners & ETAs.
- Capture decisions in the call notes doc and publish in Slack thread within 2 hours.

Unresolved questions / TODO (notes to self):
- Confirm whether AtlasHealth wants logs forwarded to their Splunk instance or prefers S3 drop. (Owner: Jonas)
- Who on Atlas side is the canonical data privacy contact? We have a legal intro but need a technical contact. (Owner: Priya)
- Create short runbook fragment for model fallback behavior during load tests. (Owner: Maya)

Appendix: short checklist for the kickoff pack (what to attach to kickoff invite)
- Agenda (30/60 min)
- Success criteria one-pager (single slide)
- Initial access checklist and sample payloads
- List of attendees + roles
- Confluence link to POC notebook

Notes to reviewer:
- This doc is intentionally lightweight — if the customer requests a formal comms plan we convert to a Confluence page and add deeper SLAs.
- Feedback requested: any missing stakeholder that must be included in escalation loop (legal, infra partner)?

-- End of draft --

(Notes: informal fragments above are expected; copy/paste templates before sending external mail.)
